creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-13 during throttled stress runs of the daemon suite (`taskpolicy -b`, load ~12): `detection::a_wait_ends_with_the_next_turn_after_a_handoff` failed once in 18 runs of the detection module, and in one earlier run it failed together with `a_finish_nobody_has_seen_is_still_unseen_after_a_handoff`, `a_working_agent_stays_working_across_a_handoff` and `a_finish_nobody_has_seen_is_kept_until_somebody_sees_it`. These tests drive the fake agent through reports and `daemon.replace`, never through USR1/USR2, so they are not the fake agent's lost byte (a_2cbKbB5Rs). Not investigated. Card a_2ccIWycOS (a handover refused under load in the CLI suite) may share a cause: a handoff step that does not survive a slow machine.
title: 🎲 Handoff detection tests fail together under load
